message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine statutory charge(s) under Chinese criminal law for illegal manufacturing of trademark. The fact: manufacturing counterfeit trademark without permission. This is violation of Trademark Law, criminal law article 210? Actually Chinese Criminal Law article 210 (as of 2015) deals with "侵犯知识产权罪" (Infringement of intellectual property rights). Specifically, illegal manufacturing of trademark is "非法制造注册商标标识罪" under Article 210 paragraph 1. The charge: "非法制造注册商标标识罪". Also possibly "侵犯商标专用权罪". But the criminal law defines "侵犯知识产权罪" includes "非法制造注册商标标识" as a specific offense. So answer: [罪名]非法制造注册商标标识罪<eoa>

Check if multiple charges: maybe also "伪造、变造国家机关印章罪"? No. So single.

Thus final answer.
